action.description: Which write operation to perform — pass its matching params object below.

name.description: Name for the new AOP/playbook, e.g. "Deals - Brazil".

cloneFromAopId.description: REQUIRED — the source user AOP id (your own, from read-playbook mode "list") to clone conversation/custom field definitions, display config, scope, icon, color, isNoOp, and the entire PLAYBOOK.md/resources/subagents document tree from. There is no from-scratch path. For a new PURE CLASSIFICATION bucket (a "Personal" category, another Spam-like filter, ...) with no automation at all, clone from an EXISTING no-op AOP (hasPlaybook: false, isNoOp: true in read-playbook mode "list" — e.g. Spam, Recruiting) rather than a live playbook AOP: the new AOP inherits isNoOp: true and, since the no-op source has no document tree, needs none either — do not try to clone a live AOP and strip it down.

selectionProcedure.description: The new AOP's routing text — what an LLM classifier reads to decide a new conversation belongs here rather than the source AOP or any other.

scope.description: Conversation ownership scope: "user" (one conversation per user+company) or "org" (one shared conversation per org+company). Defaults to the source AOP's own scope.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: target a same-org member. Omit for self; non-admins and cross-org targets are rejected.

scope.description: Field owner: user AOP or linked org AOP. list-fields returns both; CRM mappings stay user-scoped.

aopId.description: The user AOP id (scope="user") or org AOP id (scope="org") whose routing text to replace.

selectionProcedure.description: The full replacement routing text. REPLACES the existing text entirely, not a patch.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: target a same-org member user AOP (scope=user). Omit for self; non-admins and cross-org targets are rejected.

aopId.description: The user AOP id (scope="user") or org AOP id (scope="org") whose assignment instruction to replace.

customAssignmentInstruction.description: Free-text org-specific guidance appended into this AOP's domain/company-identification prompt, overriding the model's own judgment (e.g. "never treat a known vendor/TPA/recordkeeper as the deal's customer; the real customer's name typically appears in the deal title"). REPLACES the existing text entirely, not a patch. Pass null to clear it back to no override. A scope: "org" write takes effect for any user AOP under it that has no instruction of its own set, and seeds any AOP cloned afterward — it does NOT retroactively overwrite a user AOP that already has its own instruction set directly.

targetUserId.description: Org owner/admin only: target a same-org member user AOP (scope=user). Omit for self; non-admins and cross-org targets are rejected.

user_request_summary.description: One sentence, in your own words: what the user actually asked you to do in this turn. Used only for Cedar's observability — it does not change what this tool does.

is_new_request.description: true on the FIRST Cedar tool call of a NEW user request; false when this call continues the same request you are already working on. Groups related calls into one activity thread.
